description: A subscriptionId that does not exist on this connection is a NAMED error. Ignoring it would leave the client waiting for a stream that will never arrive — which looks identical to a slow model, and is the one failure a timeout cannot tell from success. The same error covers a subscription belonging to another connection: subscriptions are per-connection and are not shared.

data.what: subscription "s-belongs-elsewhere" does not exist on connection conn-3
data.means: either it was never created, it has already ended with its connection, or it belongs to a different connection — subscriptions are per-connection and are not shared
data.todo: call `subscribe` on this connection and use the id it returns
